Live positions
From community ADS-B and MLAT networks: adsb.lol (ODbL), adsb.fi, airplanes.live and the OpenSky Network. Each position keeps its own timestamp. Between reports Aeris estimates motion along the reported track and turn rate for at most ${es.extrapolate} seconds, marks positions stale after ${es.stale} seconds and removes them after ${es.lost}. Coverage depends on volunteer receivers: oceans and remote areas can be empty.

Routes and airframes
Routes come from adsbdb and hexdb, which list the usual route for a callsign. Aeris checks each route against where the aircraft is and where it is heading, and hides routes that do not fit. Registrations and owners come from adsbdb; photos from Planespotters.net, credited to each photographer.

Map and 3D
OpenStreetMap data through OpenFreeMap, satellite imagery from Esri, and terrain heights from AWS Terrain Tiles. In 3D, aircraft height uses GNSS altitude corrected with the EGM96 geoid where available, otherwise pressure altitude. Models are original and built from published dimensions; liveries are not modelled.
